subject: CHANGELOG.md includes a 1.4.0 section dated 2026-09-29 and keeps an empty Unrele
source:
uv run python -c 'from pathlib import Path
text = Path("CHANGELOG.md").read_text()
head, _, rest = text.partition("## [Unreleased]")
assert rest, "missing Unreleased"
body, sep, _tail = rest.partition("## [1.4.0] - 2026-09-29")
assert sep, "missing 1.4.0 section"
assert not body.strip(), repr(body)
assert "stays 1.3.0" not in text
print("changelog 1.4.0 ok")'
